items.t: New study examines how diabetes and weight-loss drugs affect employment and working hours
items.b: Diabetes and weight-loss medications may have economic effects beyond health care spending, according to new research from NYU Abu Dhabi. items.t: هل تبرأ ذمة المدين بدفع الدَّين إلى ابن المُقرِضة دون علمها؟
